evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth from ~4.4 to 26.2 ppm after stabilizing near 5 ppm, suggesting air ingress
Temperature holds 750 °C with heater power steady ~44%, control normal
Flow tracks 100 sccm setpoint, so MFC is not the cause
Pressure gauge not installed, so atmosphere/leak cannot be confirmed by pressure

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure trace (gauge not installed) to confirm a leak; continued O2 trend or a deliberate Ar-flow/leak-check test would discriminate seal leak from O2 sensor drift
